column7: God never takes you down! He will never run you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He is speaking from the frame of reference that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like running you down or doom and gloom? There is NO doom and gloom in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything doomy or gloomy. You’ll have to tune in to the world’s news agency for doom and gloom.
column8: God will never take you down! He never brings you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He speaks from the perspective that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and you have already received it. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **great and mighty** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like something that brings you down or like destruction and despair? There is no destruction and darkness in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything destructive or disheartening. For that you will have to turn your ears to the world’s news agency.
